He asked to retire and was changed to grand preceptor of the heir apparent in retirement. He died and was given the posthumous title Xiang.

sentences.zh: 叔明總戎年深，積聚財貨，子孫驕淫，歿才數年，遺業蕩盡。

translations.literal: Shuming commanded troops for many years, accumulated wealth and goods; his sons and grandsons were arrogant and dissolute; within only a few years after his death the inherited estate was completely squandered.
translations.idiomatic: Shuming commanded troops for many years and accumulated wealth and goods. His sons and grandsons were arrogant and dissolute, and within only a few years after his death the inherited estate was completely squandered.

sentences.zh: 裴胄，字胤叔，其先河東聞喜人，今代葬河南。

translations.literal: Pei Zhou, styled Yingshu; his ancestors were natives of Wenxi in Hedong; the present generation is buried in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Zhou, styled Yingshu, came from a family whose ancestors were natives of Wenxi in Hedong; the present generation is buried in Henan.

sentences.zh: 伯父寬，戶部尚書，有名於開元、天寶間。

translations.literal: His uncle Kuan was minister of revenue and had fame in the Kaiyuan and Tianbao eras.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Kuan was minister of revenue and had fame in the Kaiyuan and Tianbao eras.

sentences.zh: 胄明經及第，解褐補太仆寺主簿。

translations.literal: Zhou passed the classics examination and, upon leaving the robe, was appointed chief clerk of the imperial stud.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou passed the classics examination and, upon leaving the robe, was appointed chief clerk of the imperial stud.

sentences.zh: 屬二京陷覆，淪避他州。

translations.literal: When the two capitals fell, he wandered in avoidance to other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: When the two capitals fell, he wandered in avoidance to other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 賊平，授秘書省正字，累轉秘書郎。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, he was appointed rectifier of the secretariat and was repeatedly transferred to secretary.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits were pacified, he was appointed rectifier of the secretariat and was repeatedly transferred to secretary.

sentences.zh: 陳少遊陳鄭節度留後，奏胄試大理司直。

translations.literal: Chen Shaoyou, regent of the Chen and Zheng military commission, memorialized Zhou as acting assistant director of the grand court of revision.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shaoyou, regent of the Chen and Zheng military commission, memorialized Zhou as acting assistant director of the grand court of revision.

sentences.zh: 少遊罷，隴右節度李抱玉奏授監察御史，不得意，歸免。

translations.literal: When Shaoyou was dismissed, Longyou Military Commissioner Li Baoyu memorialized appointing him investigating censor; discontented, he returned and was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: When Shaoyou was dismissed, Longyou Military Commissioner Li Baoyu memorialized appointing him investigating censor. Discontented, he returned and was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 陳少遊為宣歙觀察，復辟在幕府，抱玉怒，奏貶桐廬尉。

translations.literal: Chen Shaoyou became observation commissioner of Xuan and She; again he recruited him to the staff; Baoyu was enraged and memorialized demoting him to assistant magistrate of Tonglu.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Shaoyou became observation commissioner of Xuan and She and again recruited him to the staff. Baoyu was enraged and memorialized demoting him to assistant magistrate of Tonglu.

sentences.zh: 浙西觀察使李棲筠有重望，虛心下士，幕府盛選才彥。

translations.literal: Zhexi Observation Commissioner Li Qiyun had heavy reputation; he humbly received inferior scholars; the staff greatly selected talented men.
translations.idiomatic: Zhexi Observation Commissioner Li Qiyun had heavy reputation. He humbly received inferior scholars, and the staff greatly selected talented men.

sentences.zh: 觀察判官許鴻謙有學識，棲筠常異席，事多咨之；

translations.literal: Observation aide Xu Hongqian had learning and knowledge; Qiyun often gave him a separate seat and frequently consulted him on affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Observation aide Xu Hongqian had learning and knowledge. Qiyun often gave him a separate seat and frequently consulted him on affairs;

sentences.zh: 崔造輩皆所薦引，一見胄，深重之，薦於棲筠，奏授大理評事、觀察支度使。

translations.literal: Cui Zao and his like were all recommended and introduced; on one meeting with Zhou he deeply valued him and recommended him to Qiyun; he memorialized appointing him assistant director of the grand court of revision and observation finance commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Zao and his like were all recommended and introduced. On one meeting with Zhou he deeply valued him and recommended him to Qiyun. He memorialized appointing him assistant director of the grand court of revision and observation finance commissioner.

sentences.zh: 代宗以元載隳紊朝綱，征筠入朝，內制授御史大夫，方將大用，載怙權，棲筠居顧問刺舉之職，與不平。

translations.literal: Daizong, because Yuan Zai had disordered court discipline, summoned Qiyun to court; internally he was appointed chief censor and was about to be greatly employed; Zai relied on power; Qiyun held the advisory and impeachment office and was not at peace with him.
translations.idiomatic: Daizong, because Yuan Zai had disordered court discipline, summoned Qiyun to court. Internally he was appointed chief censor and was about to be greatly employed. Zai relied on power, and Qiyun held the advisory and impeachment office and was not at peace with him.

sentences.zh: 及棲筠卒，胄護棲筠喪歸洛陽，眾論危之，胄坦然行心，無所顧望。

translations.literal: When Qiyun died, Zhou escorted Qiyun’s mourning return to Luoyang; public opinion considered this dangerous; Zhou proceeded calmly according to his heart, without looking back in concern.
translations.idiomatic: When Qiyun died, Zhou escorted Qiyun’s mourning return to Luoyang. Public opinion considered this dangerous, but Zhou proceeded calmly according to his heart, without looking back in concern.

sentences.zh: 淮南節度陳少遊奏檢校主客員外、兼侍御史、觀察判官。

translations.literal: Huainan Military Commissioner Chen Shaoyou memorialized him acting vice director of the bureau of guests, concurrent attendant censor, and observation aide.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan Military Commissioner Chen Shaoyou memorialized him acting vice director of the bureau of guests, concurrent attendant censor, and observation aide.

sentences.zh: 尋為行軍司馬，遷宣州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was made campaign staff officer and transferred to prefect of Xuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made campaign staff officer and transferred to prefect of Xuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 楊炎初作相，銳意為元載報仇，凡其枝黨無漏。

translations.literal: When Yang Yan first became chief minister, he keenly sought revenge for Yuan Zai; all his branch partisans were not missed.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Yan first became chief minister, he keenly sought revenge for Yuan Zai, and all his branch partisans were not missed.

sentences.zh: 適會胄部人積胄官時服雜俸錢為贓者，炎命酷吏員㷀深按其事，貶汀州司馬。

translations.literal: It happened that a clansman of Zhou accumulated, during Zhou’s office, official seasonal clothing and miscellaneous salary money as bribery; Yan ordered the harsh official Yuan Qiong to investigate the affair deeply and demoted him to vice magistrate of Tingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that a clansman of Zhou accumulated, during Zhou’s office, official seasonal clothing and miscellaneous salary money as bribery. Yan ordered the harsh official Yuan Qiong to investigate the affair deeply and demoted him to vice magistrate of Ting Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 尋征為少府少監，除京兆少尹，以父名不拜，換國子司業。

translations.literal: Soon he was summoned as vice director of the palace workshops, appointed junior administrator of Jingzhao; because of his father’s name he did not accept the appointment and was changed to vice director of the imperial university.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was summoned as vice director of the palace workshops and appointed junior administrator of Jingzhao. Because of his father’s name he did not accept the appointment and was changed to vice director of the imperial university.

sentences.zh: 遷湖南觀察都團練使，移江南西道。

translations.literal: He was transferred to unified training commissioner of Hunan observation and moved to Jiangnan West Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to unified training commissioner of Hunan observation and moved to Jiangnan West Circuit.

sentences.zh: 前江西觀察使李兼罷省南昌軍千余人，收其資糧，分為月進，胄至，奏其本末，罷之。

translations.literal: The former Jiangxi observation commissioner Li Jian, upon dismissal, disbanded more than a thousand Nanchang army troops, collected their supplies and grain, and divided them as monthly tribute; when Zhou arrived, he memorialized the full account from beginning to end and abolished it.
translations.idiomatic: The former Jiangxi observation commissioner Li Jian, upon dismissal, disbanded more than a thousand Nanchang army troops, collected their supplies and grain, and divided them as monthly tribute. When Zhou arrived, he memorialized the full account from beginning to end and abolished it.

sentences.zh: 會荊南節度樊澤移鎮襄陽，宰相方議其人，上首命胄代澤，仍兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: When Jingnan Military Commissioner Fan Ze moved his garrison to Xiangyang, the chief ministers were just discussing the man; the emperor first ordered Zhou to replace Ze, still concurrently chief censor.
translations.idiomatic: When Jingnan Military Commissioner Fan Ze moved his garrison to Xiangyang, the chief ministers were just discussing the man. The emperor first ordered Zhou to replace Ze, still concurrently chief censor.

sentences.zh: 胄簡儉恆一，時諸道節度觀察使競剝下厚斂，制奇錦異綾，以進奉為名。

translations.literal: Zhou was simple, frugal, and constant; at that time the various circuit military observation commissioners competed in stripping the lower levels and heavy taxation, devising strange brocades and unusual silks to advance under the name of tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou was simple, frugal, and constant. At that time the various circuit military observation commissioners competed in stripping the lower levels and heavy taxation, devising strange brocades and unusual silks to advance under the name of tribute.

sentences.zh: 又貴人宣命，必竭公藏以買其歡。

translations.literal: Also when honored persons announced edicts, they necessarily exhausted the public treasury to buy their favor.
translations.idiomatic: Also when honored persons announced edicts, they necessarily exhausted the public treasury to buy their favor.

sentences.zh: 胄待之有節，皆不盈數金，常賦之外無橫斂，宴勞禮止三爵，未嘗酣樂。

translations.literal: Zhou treated them with moderation; none exceeded several pieces of gold; beyond regular taxes there was no arbitrary levy; feasts and rewards stopped at three cups and he never drank to intoxication.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou treated them with moderation; none exceeded several pieces of gold. Beyond regular taxes there was no arbitrary levy. Feasts and rewards stopped at three cups, and he never drank to intoxication.

sentences.zh: 時武臣多廝養畜賓介，微失則奏流死，胄以書生始，奏貶書記梁易從，君子薄其進退賓客不以禮，物議薄之。

translations.literal: At that time many military men kept and raised guests and aides; a slight fault and they memorialized exile or death; Zhou, beginning as a scholar, memorialized demoting secretary Liang Yicong; gentlemen of integrity disapproved of his advancing and withdrawing guests without ritual, and public opinion slighted this.
translations.idiomatic: At that time many military men kept and raised guests and aides; a slight fault and they memorialized exile or death. Zhou, beginning as a scholar, memorialized demoting secretary Liang Yicong. Gentlemen of integrity disapproved of his advancing and withdrawing guests without ritual, and public opinion slighted this.

sentences.zh: 貞元十九年十月卒，時年七十五，贈右僕射，謚曰成。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year of Zhenyuan he died, aged seventy-five; he was posthumously enfeoffed as right vice director of the Department of State Affairs; posthumous title Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year of Zhenyuan he died at the age of seventy-five. He was posthumously enfeoffed as right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and given the posthumous title Cheng.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：三獻軍謀臣節，克紹家風。

translations.literal: The historian says: The three Zhangs’ military stratagems and ministerial integrity continued the family tradition.
translations.idiomatic: The historian says: The three Zhangs’ military stratagems and ministerial integrity continued the family tradition.

sentences.zh: 路嗣恭從微至著，執法簡廉。

translations.literal: Lu Sigong rose from obscurity to prominence, enforcing law with simplicity and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Sigong rose from obscurity to prominence, enforcing law with simplicity and integrity.

sentences.zh: 環理兵勸農，獨彰善政。

translations.literal: Huan managed troops and encouraged agriculture, alone displaying good government.
translations.idiomatic: Huan managed troops and encouraged agriculture, alone displaying good government.

sentences.zh: 漢衡誠愨奉職。

translations.literal: Hanheng was sincere and honest in fulfilling duty.
translations.idiomatic: Hanheng was sincere and honest in fulfilling duty.

sentences.zh: 朝晟忠孝權謀。

translations.literal: Chaocheng was filial, loyal, and resourceful in stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: Chaocheng was filial, loyal, and resourceful in stratagem.

sentences.zh: 澤威惠荊、襄。

translations.literal: Ze combined authority and kindness in Jing and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: Ze combined authority and kindness in Jing and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 叔明見危誓死，立政惠民。

translations.literal: Shuming, facing danger, vowed death and established government to benefit the people.
translations.idiomatic: Shuming, facing danger, vowed death and established government to benefit the people.

sentences.zh: 胄抱義危行，守政奉公。

translations.literal: Zhou upheld righteousness in perilous conduct and kept government while serving the public.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou upheld righteousness in perilous conduct and kept government while serving the public.

sentences.zh: 皆賢帥矣。

translations.literal: All were worthy commanders.
translations.idiomatic: All were worthy commanders.

sentences.zh: 然嗣恭聚財，為功名之瑕玷；

translations.literal: Yet Sigong amassed wealth—a blemish on his fame and merit;
translations.idiomatic: Yet Sigong amassed wealth—a blemish on his fame and merit;

sentences.zh: 叔明聚財，致子孫之驕淫。

translations.literal: Shuming amassed wealth, causing his sons and grandsons’ arrogance and dissoluteness.
translations.idiomatic: Shuming amassed wealth, causing his sons and grandsons’ arrogance and dissoluteness.

sentences.zh: 財之汙人，誠可誡也。

translations.literal: Wealth defiles men—truly it may serve as a warning.
translations.idiomatic: Wealth defiles men—truly it may serve as a warning.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：張、路、曲、崔、樊、楊、李、裴，守忠臣之道，皆賢帥之才。

translations.literal: The encomium says: Zhang, Lu, Qu, Cui, Fan, Yang, Li, and Pei upheld the way of loyal ministers; all had the talent of worthy commanders.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: Zhang, Lu, Qu, Cui, Fan, Yang, Li, and Pei upheld the way of loyal ministers; all had the talent of worthy commanders.
